item.text:
**Assessment**
Sharif showed a real but uneven ability to pick and empower people who could execute his program. The strongest positive evidence is in the economic and enforcement portfolios: a technocratic finance minister, an advisory council, digitalized welfare delivery, and hard-edged anti-theft campaigns with provincial and agency support. The counterevidence is also strong: family influence over cabinet formation, reliance on old-guard loyalists, and Sharif’s continued personal control over key coordination bodies.

**Accepted Claims**
- [Pakistan PM Sharif picks prominent banker in new cabinet, document shows](https://theprint.in/world/pakistan-pm-sharif-picks-prominent-banker-in-new-cabinet-document-shows/1996146/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-03-11 | Sharif chose Muhammad Aurangzeb, a career banker, for finance instead of a pure party loyalist. This is the clearest capability-seeking staffing signal in 2024. | `8B.4`, `8B.1`, `8B.2`, `7B.10`
- [Finance Division profile: Muhammad Aurangzeb](https://finance.gov.pk/profile_minister.html) | Government of Pakistan, Finance Division | 2024-03 | The ministry framed Aurangzeb’s mandate as sustainable macro stability and transparent public financial management and emphasized his long banking career. This supports the claim that the economic portfolio was staffed for competence. | `8B.4`, `8B.1`, `8B.2`
- [PM forms economic advisory council for policy guidance](https://www.thenews.com.pk/print/1190715-pm-forms-new-economic-advisory-council-without-dar-aurangzeb) | The News | 2024-05-19 | Sharif created a council of economists, technocrats, and business figures to guide policy. That is direct evidence of bringing in people with relevant expertise. | `8B.4`, `8B.1`, `8B.2`
- [PM Shehbaz directs full digitalization of social welfare payments under BISP](https://www.app.com.pk/national/pm-shehbaz-directs-full-digitalization-of-social-welfare-payments-under-bisp/) | APP | 2024-03-18 | Sharif ordered BISP payments onto digital wallets to reduce leakage, delay, and discretion. This shows he empowered a delivery mechanism that is more rule-based and administratively capable than cash discretion. | `8B.4`, `8B.2`, `8B.1`, `7B.10`
- [PM directs to minimize load-shedding](https://www.radio.gov.pk/28-05-2024/shehbaz-sharif-directs-to-minimize-load-shedding) | Radio Pakistan | 2024-05-28 | Sharif ordered an anti-power-theft campaign, monthly reviews, task forces, provincial and law-enforcement support, no overbilling, and expert hiring for DISCO privatization. This is concrete empowerment of a capable enforcement apparatus. | `8B.4`, `8B.2`, `8B.3`
- [PM directs for vigorously pursuing initiatives against spectrum of illegal activities](https://www.radio.gov.pk/29-03-2024/pm-calls-for-joint-efforts-to-check-smuggling-power-theft) | Radio Pakistan | 2024-03-29 | Sharif pushed federal and provincial institutions, including the armed forces, to act jointly against smuggling, hoarding, money laundering, and power theft. This shows he mobilized capable coercive and administrative actors for his agenda. | `8B.4`, `8B.3`, `8B.2`
- [PM orders action over ‘ineffective’ track, trace system](https://www.dawn.com/news/1832117) | Dawn | 2024-05-08 | After an inquiry report found the FBR’s track-and-trace system ineffective, Sharif ordered action against responsible officials. That is evidence of responding to performance failure by correcting personnel and administration. | `8B.4`, `8B.2`, `8B.10`
- [Pakistan to investigate army’s meddling in judiciary, law minister says](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/3/28/pakistan-to-investigate-armys-meddling-in-judiciary-law-minister-says) | Reuters via Al Jazeera | 2024-03-28 | The cabinet decided to form an inquiry commission after judges alleged ISI intimidation. That suggests Sharif sometimes empowered a politically sensitive fact-finding process instead of burying it. | `8B.4`, `8B.2`, `7B.10`
- [PM orders action against sugar mills](https://www.dawn.com/news/1873622/pm-orders-action-against-sugar-mills) | Dawn | 2024-11-20 | Sharif ordered FBR, FIA, and IB action against sugar mills and dealers for tax fraud, undocumented sales, and hoarding, plus CCTV surveillance. This is a strong example of using capable enforcement tools against a politically sensitive sector. | `8B.4`, `8B.3`, `8B.2`
- [PM orders crackdown on sugar hoarders](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2510700/pm-orders-crackdown-on-sugar-hoarders) | The Express Tribune | 2024-11-20 | Sharif directed joint action by tax, investigative, and intelligence agencies and ordered cameras at mills. This reinforces the reading that he empowered coercive administrators for implementation. | `8B.4`, `8B.3`, `8B.2`
- [PM orders action against officials over inflated bills](https://www.dawn.com/news/1844270) | Dawn | 2024-07-07 | Sharif ordered proceedings against Disco officers and instructed the FIA and power division to suspend guilty officials over inflated bills. This shows willingness to use administrative and investigative capacity against implementation failures. | `8B.4`, `8B.2`, `8B.3`
- [PM announces plan to end electricity and tax theft](https://www.dawn.com/news/1818818) | Dawn | 2024-03-03 | In his victory speech, Sharif said he would use a technological model to remove human error and end electricity and tax theft. This is direct evidence that he intended to rely on capable systems and implementers. | `8B.4`, `8B.1`, `8B.2`

**Counterevidence**
- [Nawaz busy selecting cabinet as Khawaja Asif sees PPP-‘N’ govt](https://www.dawn.com/news/1815365/nawaz-busy-selecting-cabinet-as-khawaja-asif-sees-ppp-n-govt) | Dawn | 2024-02-19 | Dawn reported that Nawaz Sharif was calling shots behind the scenes, recommending cabinet names and bureaucrats. This weakens the idea that Sharif fully selected people on capability grounds. | `8B.4`, `8B.1`, `7B.10`
- [Who are the members of PM Sharif’s new cabinet?](https://www.arabnews.pk/node/2474906/pakistan) | Arab News PK | 2024-03-12 | The cabinet was described as comprising Sharif-family loyalists, veteran politicians, and former ministers. That cuts against a clean technocratic or meritocratic staffing break. | `8B.4`, `8B.1`, `7B.10`
- [Cabinet composition report](https://www.dawn.com/news/1821157) | Dawn | 2024-03-01 | Reporting on the new cabinet said it still leaned heavily on established political figures. This suggests Sharif did not consistently prioritize capability over loyalty. | `8B.4`, `8B.1`, `7B.10`
- [PM Shehbaz relieves finance minister from key economic forum](https://www.dawn.com/news/1839967) | Dawn | 2024-06-15 | Sharif kept direct control over ECNEC rather than fully delegating to the technocrat finance minister. That weakens the case for fully empowering capable subordinates. | `8B.4`, `8B.1`, `8B.2`
- [Government clamps down on dissenting media, opposition, and NGOs](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/pakistan-widening-crackdown-dissent) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-01-11 | HRW said pressure on media and critics deepened self-censorship and fear. That shows he also empowered coercive administrators for regime protection, not just program delivery. | `8B.4`, `7B.10`, `7B.8`
- [Pakistan’s interior ministry says X was blocked on national-security grounds](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/social-media-platform-x-blocked-in-pakistan-over-national-security-ministry-says-3382313) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-04-17 | The government blocked X during a politically sensitive period, restricting criticism and monitoring. That indicates capable coercive administration, but in service of information control rather than clean program execution. | `8B.4`, `7B.10
